identificationModule.briefTitle: RC48-ADC Combinatioed Envolizumab in Locally Advanced or Metastatic Biliary Tract Cancer With Positive HER-2
identificationModule.officialTitle: RC48-ADC in Combination With Envolizumab for the First-line Treatment of Locally Advanced or Metastatic Biliary Tract Cancer With Positive HER-2: A Prospective, Single-arm Phase II Trial.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study was a prospective, single-arm phase II clinical trial to observe and evaluate the efficacy and safety of RC48-ADC combined envafolimab in the first-line treatment of locally advanced or metastatic biliary tract cancer with positive HER-2.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Percentage of participants experiencing grade 3-5 adverse events
